name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: White House teleprompter operator allegedly made over $100K betting on Trump's speeches
changes.summary: The prediction market Kalshi alleges President Trump's longtime teleprompter operator engaged in trading, betting on the words the president would use in speeches. Jo Ling Kent reports.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Both Marco Rubio and Elon Musk, who led the effort to sunset the foreign aid agency, have said that no deaths have been linked to the cutting of its funding. These parents tell a different story. (Image credit: From left: David Augustine, Lameck Nyagudi and Kazeem Olawale Nasiru for NPR).

changes.title: Takeaways from Trump's primetime speech. And, at least 2 dead in major Texas flooding
changes.summary: President Trump gave a primetime speech raising claims of voting vulnerabilities but offered no new evidence. And, at least 2 people have died in major flooding in Texas. (Image credit: Saul Loeb).

changes.title: What a Times Reporter Saw in Iran, and Takeaways from Trump’s Speech on Election Security
Trump’s Obsession With Relitigating the 2020 Election Carries a Cost for Democracy
changes.summary: In demanding steps to address the integrity of voting, President Trump persisted in relitigating his 2020 election defeat while finding ways to cast doubt on the 2026 outcome.

changes.title: Mullin pledges to go after voter fraud after Trump revives election interference claims
changes.summary: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin spoke about election security a day after President Trump claimed during his primetime address that China interfered in the 2020 election. CBS News' Jake Rosen joins to discuss Mullin's remarks.

changes.title: Maine shooting and officer's background raise new questions about ICE's rapid hiring
changes.summary: Immigration and Customs Enforcement has been rapidly expanding its workforce, hiring thousands of new officers as part of the Trump administration's attempt to ramp up immigration arrests and deportations.

changes.title: Trump Faces the Limits of U.S. Firepower and the Lessons of Past Wars
changes.summary: Like his predecessors, President Trump has struggled to turn battlefield successes into long-term victories.

changes.title: Trump Brings Full Weight of Government to Bolster False Election Claims
changes.summary: Intelligence agencies provided the White House with a trove of declassified documents that President Trump cited on Thursday as evidence of election vulnerabilities.

changes.title: Trump encourages Darline Graham to run for Lindsey Graham's seat
changes.summary: Darline Graham indicated in a White House meeting Thursday that she's weighing a bid, CBS News confirmed. A day later, President Trump wrote on Truth Social: "RUN, DARLINE, RUN! ".
